record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare POPULATION_BOMB in this production reference: TANDEMAUS (2 stars) and MAUSHOLD_THREE (3 stars) with passive FAMILY, MAUSHOLD_FOUR (4 stars) with passive NONE. The strategy is shared; differences are the star count.
record.summary: Hits the cast target repeatedly in one synchronous loop: each hit is a requested 10 SPECIAL damage that AP does not scale (apBoost false). The number of hits is round(table x (1 + AP/100)) with table 4/8/12/16/32 for stars 1-5 (32 for more), so TANDEMAUS (2 stars) makes 8, MAUSHOLD_THREE (3 stars) 12 and MAUSHOLD_FOUR (4 stars) 16 hits before AP. The cast's crit flag (one roll) multiplies every hit by critPower; each hit is reduced separately by the target's SPE_DEF with a minimum of 1, so the total is the sum of per-hit results, not one big hit.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not read.

effects.scaling: AP changes the number of hits, not the damage per hit: hits = Math.round(table x (1 + AP/100)); per hit requested amount is 10 (apBoost false so handleSpecialDamage adds no AP); the cast's crit flag multiplies each hit by critPower (reduced by the target's critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: intermediate, not guaranteed final HP damage: each hit goes through handleSpecialDamage, which deals nothing when the target is protected, skydiving or has magicBounce, then handleDamage divides by (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF) (ceil, min 1) among other steps (shield, Shiny Charm, Fossil, Cover Band, resurrection: shared helper, see core-mechanics.md section A, not re-traced here). The 10 raw is therefore at least 1 per hit after defence and the per-hit ceil applies 'hits' times. Once the target's hp is 0 the remaining hits return takenDamage 0. The strategy ignores the returned takenDamage.

starBehavior.note: the table is indexed by the casting entity's stars (index stars-1; 32 for stars above 5); the 1-star value 4 and the 5-star value 32 are not reachable by these three units. maxPP is 100 and range 1 for all three. Raw total before AP-scaling the count, defence and misses: 80 / 120 / 160. FAMILY (TANDEMAUS, MAUSHOLD_THREE) has no handler in app/core or app/config, so it was not found to change this cast.

record.positionalConditions: None read beyond needing a target (the unit must be in range of it to cast, since requiresTarget is true).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast recomputes the hit count from the caster's current AP and repeats the loop.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: 10 per hit, 8 / 12 / 16 hits for 2 / 3 / 4 stars before AP. Hits = round(table x (1 + AP/100)). Each hit = 10 [x critPower on a crit], then SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1) and untraced modifiers, summed over the hits; 0 for hits blocked by protect / skydiving / magicBounce or landing after the target died.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (shield, items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers): only the SPE_DEF step was cited; core-mechanics.md section A was consulted for the rest
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence); only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate in the attacking state was read
Crit resolution: only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate in castAbility was read
Per-hit side effects inside handleSpecialDamage/handleDamage (spell-damage counters, PP gain of the target, on-damage item or synergy effects) triggered up to 16 times per cast were not enumerated
unresolved: Whether any item or synergy effect changes POPULATION_BOMB beyond what is listed
What the FAMILY passive does at runtime: only the enum value was found in app/core and app/config; other directories were not searched
Resurrection and other death-cancelling paths on the target were not enumerated; they would change which hits land
Large AP: the hit count has no cap in the strategy (Math.round of the scaled table); cost or limits elsewhere were not traced
